description: This file contains the server-side code-behind for the 'TheorySet' ASP.NET WebForm in the OnlineExamSystem project. It manages UI events such as page load, course selection, question addition, and exam setup, and interacts with a SQL database to store and retrieve question and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for ASP.NET WebForm page 'TheorySet', handling UI events and database interactions related to theory questions and course details.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; currently empty with commented code.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminPanel.aspx when 'home' button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminQueue.aspx for profile-related actions.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to AdminLeaderboard.aspx to view leaderboard.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates 'SelectCourseDropDownList' based on selected semester, offering course options.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question to the 'theoryQS' database table, updates question number, and alerts user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new course exam detail into 'theoryCourseDetail' and navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Fetches current question count for selected course and updates question number display.
